summary: The change implements `get RegExp.prototype.dotAll` per the spec. The getter passes `this` through, uses code unit 0x0073, and calls an in-file `regexp_has_flag` helper. That helper follows RegExpHasFlag steps 1-5 in order: the non-Object TypeError, the [[OriginalFlags]] check with the SameValue(%RegExp.prototype%) → undefined branch and the TypeError otherwise, then the flags-contains check returning a Boolean. Spec step comments sit above the matching code. No test-keyed branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values, and no changes outside the one file. The helper is local to the file; sibling flag getters will likely need it too, so a later ticket may move it into support.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. The local `regexp_has_flag` helper in prototype_get_dot_all.rs is a candidate to move into a shared support module once the other RegExp flag getters (global, ignoreCase, multiline, sticky, unicode, etc.) are implemented, so they do not duplicate it.
